Question 12
?

Let f(x,y)=xey. Find the linear approximation of f at the point (−1,ln⁡2).

a
f(x,y)≈2ln⁡2+2x−2y
b
f(x,y)≈2ln⁡2+2x+y
c
f(x,y)≈−2+2x−2y
d
f(x,y)≈2ln⁡2−x−y
e
f(x,y)≈−2−x+y
